summary: Tested (1) ritenuta_xml vs anagrafica ritenuta on XML passive upload + /passive list amber badge, (2) dashboard RitenuteF24Avviso for unpaid ritenute months with past/near F24 deadline. Backend 12/12 pytest pass; UI verified end to end (badges, red 'scaduto' banner, F24 PDF download, link to /ritenute?mese=, versato from UI removes banner). Today in env = 2026-11-20, so only the red/past state was reproducible (amber state not reachable: Oct deadline already past, Nov still provisional).

issues: Same overdue ritenute F24 is shown three times: global red top bar ('F24 1040 ritenute ... scaduto'), new rit-f24-avviso banner, and 'Ritenute d'acconto da versare' card. Consider hiding one.
Data versamento uses the browser's native date input (mm/dd/yyyy in en locale) instead of the shadcn calendar (was already there before).

critical_code_review_comments: Passive.jsx badge says 'anagrafica y' even when the user later changed the ritenuta by hand (PUT /passive/{id}/ritenuta, ritenuta_auto=false), because ritenuta_xml stays and the label is fixed. Consider changing the label to 'registrata y' or hiding it when ritenuta_auto is false.
RitenuteF24Avviso uses giorni<=6. When the 16th falls on a weekend the deadline moves to the next working day (f24._lavorativo), so the banner starts on the 11th or 12th, not on the 10th. Minor.
Docs uploaded before this change get ritenuta_xml set from the current ritenuta_importo on riallinea, so they never show the badge, even when the XML differed. Expected, but worth knowing.
server.py is 4988 lines and should be split into smaller modules.
